description: Tool failure recovery: the first tool call errors (read of a file that does not exist), the failure must land durably in the session log, and the same turn must recover with a successful write and still end completed — no restart, no lost turn
prompt: RECOVER_AFTER_TOOL_FAILURE: read missing-input.txt, then write recovery.txt with the recovery note.

checks.name: failed-call-is-durable
checks.run:
python3 -c "
import json, os
events = [json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['BLAZORLY_SESSION_LOG']) if l.strip()]
calls = {e['data']['callId']: e['data'] for e in events if e.get('type') == 'tool/call'}
failed = [e for e in events if e.get('type') == 'tool/result'
          and any(b.get('isError') for b in e['data']['message']['content'])]
assert failed, 'no durable tool failure in the log'
first = failed[0]['data']
code = (first.get('error') or {}).get('code')
assert code == 'FILE_NOT_FOUND', code
call = calls.get(first['message']['source']['callId'])
assert call and call['name'] == 'read', call
assert 'missing-input.txt' in call['arguments'], call['arguments']
"

checks.name: recovered-in-the-same-turn
checks.run:
python3 -c "
import json, os
events = [json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['BLAZORLY_SESSION_LOG']) if l.strip()]
results = [e for e in events if e.get('type') == 'tool/result']
failed = [e for e in results if any(b.get('isError') for b in e['data']['message']['content'])]
assert failed, 'no failure to recover from'
failure = failed[0]
ok = [e for e in results if e['seq'] > failure['seq']
      and not any(b.get('isError') for b in e['data']['message']['content'])]
assert ok, 'no successful tool result after the failure'
calls = {e['data']['callId']: e['data'] for e in events if e.get('type') == 'tool/call'}
recovery = calls[ok[0]['data']['message']['source']['callId']]
assert recovery['name'] == 'write', recovery
assert failure['data']['turn'] == ok[0]['data']['turn'], 'recovery happened in a different turn'
"

checks.name: recovery-artifact-written
checks.run:
python3 -c "
text = open('recovery.txt').read()
assert 'recovered' in text, text
"

checks.name: one-turn-ended-completed
checks.run:
python3 -c "
import json, os
events = [json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['BLAZORLY_SESSION_LOG']) if l.strip()]
starts = [e['data']['turn'] for e in events if e.get('type') == 'turn/start']
ends = [(e['data']['turn'], e['data']['reason']['kind']) for e in events if e.get('type') == 'turn/end']
assert starts == [1], starts
assert ends == [(1, 'completed')], ends
"
